Backwashing returns a card from the acting player GY, so that card cannot supply the opposing Hand.
Exploring adds to the acting player Hand. Opposing Hand or Deck supplies its own resource.
Scarlet draws into the acting player Hand. Opponent needs an existing resource.
Bobbie summons itself. Opponent needs an existing resource.

engine: The reviewed core returns false from Card.IsCanBeSpecialSummoned while a card is in the Monster Zone. A direct reuse of the hand filter cannot model the prospective field-to-hand move. Keep resolution using actual hand eligibility.

activationApiReview.finding: Rejects the selected card while in MZONE, before evaluating summon conditions.
Checks player restrictions against the card in its current state. It does not evaluate the target in a hypothetical Hand state.
Uses a card data record, not the card’s post-return effects and location.
Action-permission gated and creates a card outside any location, so it cannot model Hand legality as a read-only activation check.
The installed reference lists card properties but no location assumption.
